title: Madusa pursues Akira Hokuto’s championship
summary: WCW’s new women’s championship puts Madusa opposite Akira Hokuto. Their rivalry culminates with Madusa staking her career on finally winning the belt.

chapters.title: Hokuto becomes the inaugural champion
chapters.result: Hokuto defeats Madusa in the Women’s title tournament final.
chapters.context: The tournament establishes a champion and gives Madusa a specific rival to pursue.

chapters.title: Madusa loses the title-versus-career match
chapters.context: The loss triggers Madusa’s on-screen retirement stipulation; it is not the permanent end of her wrestling career.
